_source: Enemy.vb. Screen units, per frame. maxEnemy 13 is 14 enemies; mass is massBase + massRandom x rand. loadHP is loadEnemy's, resetHP Root.vb Reset's (every wave is a reset's). cautiousSeekMultiple is the Cautious state's 6 x seekSpd.

port._about: Not in the original. radius is world units, never mapped. seekCap (UNI-T65) is how many enemies may Seek at once (14 would let every one seek, as the original does); 4 keeps a steady stream at the angel, one or two to a side, that a swing or two can answer, while the other ten circle and close in the moment a seeker is hurt, grabbed or killed. hangBackNear and hangBackFar (screen units, mapped by space.json) are the band the waiting ten hold: Align stalks in to the near edge, one angel width (angelSize 0.3) out, and Cautious backs off to the far edge, half as far again.
